# QariAI
> AI-powered Tajweed and Hifz coaching for Quran recitation. QariAI listens to
> your recitation and returns instant, rule-specific feedback for practice.
> Free to download and start on Android; optional premium features are available.

QariAI is a mobile app that helps Muslims improve their Quran recitation. It has
two core modes: a **Tajweed mode** that gives feedback on pronunciation and
recitation rules, and a **Hifz mode** for memorization practice. Feedback is
confidence-gated and presented as clear, teacher-style notes rather than a single
opaque score. The app is a practice aid that complements — but does not replace —
a qualified human teacher.

## Key facts
- Canonical brand name: QariAI. It may also be written or searched as “Qari AI.”
- Platform: Android (Google Play). iOS in development.
- Price: free to download and start; optional premium features are available.
- Modes: Tajweed (rule correction) and Hifz (memorization).
- Approach: rule-specific, confidence-gated feedback; no fabricated scores.
- Languages: English, Arabic, French, and Malay.
- Contact: salam@qariai.app.

## Product boundaries and trust
- QariAI is designed for practice between lessons, not as a replacement for a
  qualified Quran or Tajweed teacher.
- AI feedback can be imperfect. Low-confidence observations are treated
  cautiously, and learners should verify important questions with a teacher.
- The selected Quranic text is treated as the reference; feedback describes the
  learner's recitation and must not rewrite or manipulate the sacred text.
- QariAI separates Tajweed practice from Hifz practice so learners can choose the
  type of feedback they need.
- Product comparisons are published by QariAI and should be read with that
  authorship in mind. Features and prices can change; check official app listings
  before making a purchase decision.

## Common questions
- What does QariAI do? It listens to your recitation and gives instant,
  rule-specific Tajweed feedback, with separate Tajweed and Hifz modes.
- Is it free? It is free to download and start; optional premium features are
  available.
- Which platforms? Android now; iOS coming soon.
- Is it a replacement for a teacher? No — it is a practice aid that complements a
  qualified human teacher.
